questions.question: Which ancient Near Eastern god was particularly associated with sacrificial rituals and often worshiped in temples?
questions.explanation: Marduk is the chief god of Babylonian mythology and played a central role in religious life, especially in sacrificial rituals and temple economy. He was revered as a creator god and had a significant influence on religious practices in ancient Mesopotamia.

choices: Which of the following lakes is the largest by surface area?

questions.question: The Caspian Sea is often considered the largest lake in the world as it occupies the greatest area. It is located between Europe and Asia and has no natural outflows, classifying it as an endorheic body of water.
choices: Which ancient Greek astronomer developed the geocentric model that viewed the Earth as the center of the universe?

questions.question: Ptolemy lived in the 2nd century AD and was known for his geocentric model that placed the Earth at the center of the universe. This model influenced astronomical thinking for many centuries.
choices: Which music genre is closely associated with the culture of the 1920s in Germany and often linked with the term 'Jazz'?

questions.question: Cabaret music experienced a boom in 1920s Germany and was often characterized by jazz elements. This music genre was an important part of the cultural scene of the Weimar Republic, reflecting the societal changes of the time.
choices: Which floral organ is primarily responsible for reproduction and seed formation?

questions.question: The carpel is the female reproductive organ of the flower and contains the ovules. After fertilization, the carpel develops into the fruit, which protects and disperses the seeds.

choices: Which technology is commonly used for contactless payments with smartphones?

NFC (Near Field Communication) is the most common technology for contactless payments with smartphones as it enables fast and secure device connections. Bluetooth and RFID are also related technologies but less common for mobile payment applications. QR codes offer another method of payment by scanning information, but they require a camera and are not contactless.
